name: Gezamushi
source:
A scion of a rich and powerful family gets a vacation that he plans to spend chasing girls and committing them to sensual pleasures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名出身豪門、家中有權有勢的繼承人迎來了假期，並打算在這段時間裡追逐女孩，讓她們沉溺於肉慾之中。
